sections.title: Accessing the SNSOP MIS
sections.bodyHtml:
Login to access this SNSOP MIS Portal:

https://newmis.southsudansafetynet.info/trial/payment/#/dashboard

Enter Users Email and Password (Registered Microsoft Account)

After logging in, the User will enter their dashboard.

Introduction of SNSOP MIS

The South Sudan National Safety Net Operations Project Management Information System (SNSOP MIS) is a comprehensive digital platform designed to efficiently manage beneficiary data, program operations, and payment processes for social protection interventions across South Sudan. The system supports transparent, accurate, and accountable program implementation by integrating end-to-end functionalities such as beneficiary registration and management, verification and audit tracking, project and sub-project management, attendance monitoring, wage request workflows, payroll processing, and detailed reporting.

SNSOP MIS enables role-based access for different stakeholders including administrators, implementing partners, engineers, reviewers, financial approvers, and service providers—ensuring strong governance and control at every stage. With real-time dashboards, county-wise monitoring, automated approval flows, biometric matching support, mobile money integration, and SurveyCTO data synchronization, the system strengthens data-driven decision-making and enhances operational efficiency. Overall, SNSOP MIS serves as a reliable backbone for delivering inclusive, transparent, and effective safety net services to vulnerable populations.

sections.title: Beneficiary Dashboard
sections.bodyHtml:
Click the Beneficiary Module to access the Beneficiary Dashboard

After selecting Beneficiary , the system displays a summary dashboard containing key indicators:

1.1 Summary Cards▾

Total Beneficiaries : Shows the total number of beneficiaries registered in the system.

Female : Displays the number of female beneficiaries.

LIPW : Displays the number of beneficiaries enrolled under the LIPW program.

1.2 Summary Tabs▾

Summary ALL : Overall beneficiary statistics.

Summary PP : Parent Project

Summary AF : Additional Finance

1.3. County-wise Registered Households▾

Displays a bar chart showing:

Beneficiary count per county

Target count per county

Used for monitoring coverage and performance against targets.

Beneficiary Update, Beneficiary View, Update Approval, Beneficiary Audit, Restore Beneficiary, New Registration, Pending Verification can be performed from the Beneficiary Management .

sections.title: Beneficiary Manage
sections.bodyHtml:
For “Beneficiary Manage”, follow the steps below:

Beneficiary Update▾

For “Beneficiary Update”, follow the steps below:

After Login, Click on the Beneficiary Module

Click the Beneficiary Manage menu

From the dropdown, navigate to and select Beneficiary Update

By default, Beneficiary List will be shown. The list can also be retrieved by searching by specific information from the search criteria.

Click the Search button to retrieve the relevant Beneficiary for Update

User can navigate the View, Edit, Migrate and Archive functionality. The View button here works as the same beneficiary list.

Click on edit button to Edit the beneficiary information

User can Edit Personal Information, Alternate Payee Information, Nominee Information from here.

After Edit the Beneficiary Information, Click on Update button

User can Migrate Beneficiary (Payam/Boma)

Change or update the GEO location (Payam, Boma) for Migration Click on Migrate button

User can check and Approve or Reject the migration from Update Approval .

By default, Beneficiary List will be shown. The list can also be retrieved by searching by specific information from the search criteria. User can select task type – Migrate, Approval Status - Pending also.

Click the Search button to retrieve the Pending beneficiary

Click View button to open the Beneficiary Migration Details

After check the Beneficiary Migration Details

Click Approve button

Click Yes to confirm Migration

User can Archive Beneficiaries from here.

Write a Comment and Click Yes to send Archive request.

After the beneficiary archive request is sent

Click the Beneficiary Manage menu

From the dropdown, navigate to and select Update Approval

By default, Beneficiary List will be shown. The list can also be retrieved by searching by specific information from the search criteria. User can select Application ID, Approval Status, task type – Archive, Approval Status - Pending also.

Click the Search button to retrieve pending beneficiary

Click View button to open the pending Beneficiary Details

After check the Beneficiary Archiving reason and details

Click Approve button to confirm the Archive

Update Approval▾

For “Update Approval”, follow the steps below:

After Login, Click on the Beneficiary Module

Click the Beneficiary Manage menu

From the dropdown, navigate to and select Update Approval

By default, Beneficiary List will be shown. The list can also be retrieved by searching by specific information from the search criteria.

Click the Search button to retrieve the relevant Beneficiary for approval

Click on the View button to open the Beneficiary details page

User can Approve or Reject selected beneficiaries by clicking Approve or Reject button

Write a comment and Click yes for the Update Approval

Approved updates reflect in the beneficiary list

For “Beneficiary Audit”, follow the steps below:

After Login, Click on the Beneficiary Module

Click the Beneficiary Manage menu

From the dropdown, navigate to and select Beneficiary Audit

By default, Beneficiary Audit List will be shown. The list can also be retrieved by searching by specific information from the search criteria.

Click the Search button to retrieve the relevant Pending Beneficiary

Click the View button to view the Beneficiary Audit Details

User can see what changes have been made to the beneficiary by selecting the version from the Select Revision dropdown.

User Information tab shows information about user ID, Revision Type, Time of Revision

Select the beneficiary record

Check Yes for Wallet Number Update

Payment Method Wise Beneficiary List Report▾

For “Complete Household Survey Report”, follow the steps below:

After Login, Click on the Beneficiary Module

Click the Beneficiary Report menu

From the dropdown, navigate to and Select Payment Method Wise Beneficiary List Report

Select Filters

Fill in the required fields:

Location Details

State Name → Select (e.g., UPPER NILE)

County Name → Select (e.g., MELUTH)

Payam Name → Select (e.g., MELUT)

Boma Name → Select (e.g., BAIBAI)

Registration Details

Registration Phase

AF → Active phase

PARENT → Parent category

Support Type

Options:

ALL

LIPW

DIS

Payment Method

Options:

ALL

Cash

Mobile Money

Select Mobile Wallet Status Filter

Options:

Has Mobile Wallet Number

Does Not Have Mobile Wallet

Select status if needed

Otherwise leave as default

Generate Report

Click Generate button

System will display results (if available)

If no data matches:

Message shown: “No beneficiaries found for the selected criteria.”

Download Report

Once data is generated:

Click Download PDF → to export as PDF

Click Download CSV → to export as Excel/CSV

Reset Filters

Click Reset button

This clears all selected filters

Async Report Generation▾

For “Complete Household Survey Report”, follow the steps below:

After Login, Click on the Beneficiary Module

Click the Beneficiary Report menu

From the dropdown, navigate to and Select Async Report Generation

Dashboard Summary (Top Status Boxes)

At the top, you will see 5 status indicators:

Total → Total number of reports

Pending → Reports not started yet

Processing → Reports currently being generated

Completed → Successfully generated reports

Failed → Reports that failed

These help you quickly understand the overall report status.

Generate Report

Steps:

Select a Report Type from the dropdown

Additional fields may appear depending on the selection

Fill in the required information

Click to generate the report

The generated report will appear in the Report History section.

Report History

This section shows all previously generated reports.

Columns:

Format → File type (e.g., CSV)

Status → Current state of the report

COMPLETED ✅

FAILED ❌

IN PROGRESS ⏳

Created At → Date and time of creation

Actions → Download option

Filters

Status Filter:

All Status → Show all reports

Pending → Only pending reports

In Progress → Reports being processed

Completed → Finished reports

Failed → Failed reports

Date Filter:

Start Date → Beginning date

End Date → Ending date

Use filters to quickly find specific reports.

Download Report

Reports with COMPLETED status will have a download option

Click the download icon to save the report

Failed reports cannot be downloaded

Pagination

Page numbers (1, 2, 3, etc.) are shown at the bottom

Click a number to navigate between pages

Click Download to download a combined report (PP + AF)/All

sections.title: Project
sections.bodyHtml:
For create a “Project”, follow the steps below:

Log in as Implementing Partner (IP) by using IP credentials

Click on Payment Module

Click the Project menu

From the dropdown, navigate to and select Create New Project

Fill up the Project page fields with necessary information

Give Project Name, Start Date, End date, Project Sanction Date, Target Beneficiaries, Project Cost (USD), Person Incharge , Mobile, E-mail, Status

Input state/county and click on Add New button

Click the Save button

After clicking the Save button you will see a Success message.

If IP want to see the project list, IP can check the project and see what updates it has.

sections.bodyHtml:
After completing the Project Registration, create a Sub-Project .

For create the Sub Project , follow the steps below:

Log in as Implementing Partner (IP) by using IP credentials

Click on Payment Module

Click the Sub Project menu

From the dropdown, navigate to and select Create New Sub-Project

Select Project name from dropdown and there will show target checkbox click on it

Select Type of meeting – Approval Meeting

Give a meeting date

Select Payam & Boma name

Select the “Paper Screening Status” dropdown

sections.title: Accessing the SNSOP MIS
sections.bodyHtml:
Login to access this SNSOP MIS Portal:

https://newmis.southsudansafetynet.info/trial/payment/#/dashboard

Enter Users Email and Password (Registered Microsoft Account)

After logging in, the User will enter their dashboard.

Introduction of SNSOP MIS

The South Sudan National Safety Net Operations Project Management Information System (SNSOP MIS) is a comprehensive digital platform designed to efficiently manage beneficiary data, program operations, and payment processes for social protection interventions across South Sudan. The system supports transparent, accurate, and accountable program implementation by integrating end-to-end functionalities such as beneficiary registration and management, verification and audit tracking, project and sub-project management, attendance monitoring, wage request workflows, payroll processing, and detailed reporting.

SNSOP MIS enables role-based access for different stakeholders including administrators, implementing partners, engineers, reviewers, financial approvers, and service providers—ensuring strong governance and control at every stage. With real-time dashboards, county-wise monitoring, automated approval flows, biometric matching support, mobile money integration, and SurveyCTO data synchronization, the system strengthens data-driven decision-making and enhances operational efficiency. Overall, SNSOP MIS serves as a reliable backbone for delivering inclusive, transparent, and effective safety net services to vulnerable populations.

Reject → Send back with comments

Continue approving other draft requests from the list.

sections.title: Accessing the SNSOP MIS
sections.bodyHtml:
Login to access this SNSOP MIS Portal:

https://newmis.southsudansafetynet.info/trial/payment/#/dashboard

Enter Users Email and Password (Registered Microsoft Account)

After logging in, the User will enter their dashboard.

Introduction of SNSOP MIS

The South Sudan National Safety Net Operations Project Management Information System (SNSOP MIS) is a comprehensive digital platform designed to efficiently manage beneficiary data, program operations, and payment processes for social protection interventions across South Sudan. The system supports transparent, accurate, and accountable program implementation by integrating end-to-end functionalities such as beneficiary registration and management, verification and audit tracking, project and sub-project management, attendance monitoring, wage request workflows, payroll processing, and detailed reporting.

SNSOP MIS enables role-based access for different stakeholders including administrators, implementing partners, engineers, reviewers, financial approvers, and service providers—ensuring strong governance and control at every stage. With real-time dashboards, county-wise monitoring, automated approval flows, biometric matching support, mobile money integration, and SurveyCTO data synchronization, the system strengthens data-driven decision-making and enhances operational efficiency. Overall, SNSOP MIS serves as a reliable backbone for delivering inclusive, transparent, and effective safety net services to vulnerable populations.

Introduction of SNSOP MIS

The South Sudan National Safety Net Operations Project Management Information System (SNSOP MIS) is a comprehensive digital platform designed to efficiently manage beneficiary data, program operations, and payment processes for social protection interventions across South Sudan. The system supports transparent, accurate, and accountable program implementation by integrating end-to-end functionalities such as beneficiary registration and management, verification and audit tracking, project and sub-project management, attendance monitoring, wage request workflows, payroll processing, and detailed reporting.

SNSOP MIS enables role-based access for different stakeholders including administrators, implementing partners, engineers, reviewers, financial approvers, and service providers—ensuring strong governance and control at every stage. With real-time dashboards, county-wise monitoring, automated approval flows, biometric matching support, mobile money integration, and SurveyCTO data synchronization, the system strengthens data-driven decision-making and enhances operational efficiency. Overall, SNSOP MIS serves as a reliable backbone for delivering inclusive, transparent, and effective safety net services to vulnerable populations.

sections.title: Payroll
sections.bodyHtml:
1.1. Payroll Generate▾

For “Payroll Generate”, follow the steps below:

· Log in as FSP (Financial Service Provider) by using FSP credentials

· Click on Payment Module

· Click the Payroll menu

· From the dropdown, navigate to and select Payroll Generate

· Select State, County, Payam, Boma, Support Type, Payment Cycle

· Select Payment Type Cash or Mobile Money

· Select “Single Payroll” for individual payment cycle or Select “Combined Payroll” for multiple

· Click the Generate Payroll button

· Click the Yes button to Confirm Payroll Generation

There will have a successful payroll generation initiation message

1.2. Cash Payroll Download▾

For “Payroll Generate”, follow the steps below:

· Log in as FSP (Financial Service Provider) by using FSP credentials

· Click on Payment Module

· Click the Payroll menu

From the dropdown, navigate to and select Cash Payroll Download

· Select State, County, Payam, Boma name and Status

· Click the Search button to retrieve the data

From the Payment Generation for Cash Payments list -

· Click the PDF button to download as PDF file

· Click the .bin button to download as Binary file

You can see the download Success message.

1.3. Mobile Money▾

· Click on Payment Module

· Click the Payroll menu

· From the dropdown, navigate to and Select Mobile Money

The Payroll Generation screen will appear. From the Search & Filter Section -

· Select State name, County name, Payam name, Boma name

· Select LIPW/DIS/All from the Support Type dropdown

· Check the Single Payroll if you want to generate Single one

· Check the Combined Payroll if you want to generate Combined

· Select the Payment Cycle from the Payment Cycle dropdown

· Select Mobile Money from the Payment Type dropdown

· Click the Generate button to generate the payroll

When you Click on generate button with payment type mobile money, the payroll generation initiate successfully.

Then the payroll will be in mobile money sub-menu.

· Click on the mobile money sub-menu

After the Mobile Money page will appear.

· Click the view button to see the details

· Click the Proceed button to initiate the Mobile Money payment

· Click on Payment Module

· Click the Payroll menu

From the dropdown, navigate to and Select Reconciliation Monitoring

The Reconciliation Monitoring page will appear. From the Search & Filter Section -

· Select State name, County name, Payam name, Boma name

From the Payment Cycle Type:

· Check Single if you want to generate Single one

· Check Combined if you want to generate Combined

· Click the View button to see the details

You can Filter for the beneficiary details.

You can Search name from Filter by search name option or you also can search filter by alternate.

· Select LIPW/DIS/All from the support type option

· Select Paid/Unpaid/All Status from the status dropdown

After Selecting, eligible beneficiary payment list will appear.
